Required gm1 is about 2*pi*29MHz*2pF = 364uS; I target about 520uS, i.e. 34uA per side at gm/Id 15. The 68uA tail plus the 10uA reference gives 154uW at 1.98V. Slew is about 34V/us. Medium L on the input pair and the load gives gain margin. The tail at gm/Id 12 keeps Vdsat low for headroom at ss/-40C."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 19.0),   # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.6, 0.3, 1.2),      # input pair L
    "gmid3": (9.0, 6.0, 12.0),     # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "L3":    (0.8, 0.5, 1.5),      # PMOS load L
    "gmid5": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),    # tail / bias mirror gm/Id
    "L5":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),      # tail / bias mirror L
    "Itail": (68e-6, 50e-6, 80e-6) # tail current
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    It = p["Itail"]
    Id1 = It / 2.0

    # Input pair. Vds is roughly vout - vtail, about 1.1 - 0.2.
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Id1, vds=0.7, vsb=0.2)
    # PMOS mirror load (the diode side sets Vsd = |Vgs|).
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], Id1, vds=0.75)
    # Tail and its reference diode (same L and gm/Id; the tail is a scaled copy).
    vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.15)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmid5"], p["L5"], It, vds=vtail)
    m6 = lut.size("n", p["gmid5"], p["L5"], iref, vds=m5.vgs)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # Bias: IREF flows into ibias, so the diode-connected nfet sinks it.
    n.dev("M6", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m6)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # Diff pair. vinp drives the output side (non-inverting), vinn drives the diode side.
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    # PMOS mirror load
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m3.gds
    A0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    # Mirror pole/zero doublet
    cx = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cx)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fp2)))
    slew = It / cout
    # Settling: slew phase plus about 4.6 time constants of linear settling
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.3 / slew + 4.6 * tau
    # Thermal noise, with a 2x allowance for flicker at 1 kHz
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    sn = 2 * (8 * kT / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    noise = 2.0 * math.sqrt(sn)
    # CMRR is about 2*gm3*gm1/(gds5*gds_x) roughly; use a first-order estimate
    cmrr = db(2 * gm1 * m3.gm / (m5.gds * (m1.gds + m3.gds) + 1e-30) / A0) + 6
    psrr = db(A0) + 0.0
    swing = (vdd - m3.vdsat - 0.1) - (vtail + m1.vdsat + 0.05)
    power = vdd * (It + iref)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew, "settle": settle,
        "noise_1k": noise, "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr, "swing": swing,
        "power": power,
    }
```
